about: How an agent's manifest says an AI twin's policy (design/specs/cli.md §7.4, #2694): each case's manifest, and its policy sections as `canyon manifest --format ai` and the dashboard's What agents are told both print them. cli/manifest_test.go and web/src/screens/Guardrails.test.tsx read this one table, so the two renderings cannot drift.

cases.name: the scanner rule blocks and its twin only warns
cases.agent:
Policies that block:
- No hand-built SQL
  To pass: Bind it.
  In languages Canyon's scanners cover, it blocks; in the rest only the AI review checks it, if one is set up, and it only warns.

cases.name: both only warn

policies.name: No user input in commands (AI review)

cases.agent:
Policies that only warn:
- No user input in commands

cases.name: the twin blocks and its scanner rule only warns
cases.agent:
Policies that block:
- No hand-built SQL
  To pass: Bind it, says the twin.
  In languages Canyon's scanners cover, it only warns; in the rest only the AI review checks it, if one is set up, and it blocks.
